market_narrative.summary: US equities are carrying a cautious to risk-off bias as inflation, Fed/rates, oil/energy shape positioning. Investors are balancing selective leadership against the risk that policy, rates or growth data broadens the pressure.

index_performance_summary: Nasdaq and growth indexes should be the most sensitive part of the tape when AI, semiconductor, mega-cap tech, or guidance stories dominate. S&P 500 direction is likely to remain tied to Treasury yields, Fed expectations, inflation data, and broad risk appetite. Dow and equal-weight exposure may react more to policy, regulation, tariff, and industrial-cycle headlines.
macro_outlook: Macro coverage is concentrated around Fed/rates (184), inflation (179), oil/energy (90), tariffs/policy (63). The practical implication is that equity rallies may need confirmation from rates and inflation expectations; if yields rise while growth headlines weaken, risk appetite can fade quickly.
risk_and_sentiment: Sentiment is cautious to risk-off: 183 positive, 297 negative, and 1130 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
